title: Truly Voxarian World
description: Makes the Minecraft environment feel like a simulation, not a backdrop. An addition for the Voxarian World Modpack
body:
# Truly Voxarian World

Truly Voxarian World is a Minecraft Fabric mod designed for the **[Voxarian World](https://modrinth.com/modpack/voxarian-world)** modpack. It introduces factors and mechanics to minecraft 1.20.1 that make the world feel like a simulation and not just a backdrop.

## 🛠 Current Features

- **Soil Health System**: Farmland has health that degrades when crops are harvested, encouraging careful management.
- **Harvest Costs**: Mature crops consume more soil vitality than immature ones.
- **Monoculture Penalty**: Planting the same crop too densely nearby incurs an additional penalty.
- **Crop Rotation Bonus**: Switching crop types on the same plot grants a health bonus.
- **Daily Regeneration**: Bare farmland recovers health each in-game day, accelerated by nearby companion flowers.
- **Soil Checker Tool**: Inspect soil health, check for companion flowers, and see current crop status.

## 🎮Gameplay

- Harvesting crops reduces the health of the underlying farmland.
- Dense planting of the same crop triggers a monoculture penalty.
- Rotating crops provides a one-time health boost.
- Empty farmland regenerates daily, with bonuses from companion flowers.
- Use the Soil Checker item for real-time soil analysis.
